name: Bittensor
description: Decentralized machine learning network where miners and validators contribute and earn from training and serving AI models across specialized subnets.

name: Render
description: Decentralized GPU compute network that connects artists and developers needing rendering and AI inference with idle GPU providers worldwide.

name: Akash Network
description: Decentralized open-source cloud computing marketplace (DeCloud) that allows anyone to rent out or lease compute resources, including GPU instances for AI workloads.

name: The Graph
description: Indexing protocol for organizing and querying blockchain data via GraphQL APIs, providing the data layer that AI agents and dApps rely on.

name: Fetch.ai
description: Decentralized machine learning platform building autonomous AI agents and the Artificial Superintelligence Alliance (ASI) with SingularityNET and Ocean Protocol.

name: SingularityNET
description: Decentralized AI marketplace where developers can publish, monetize, and compose AI services at scale, now part of the Artificial Superintelligence Alliance.

name: Ocean Protocol
description: Decentralized data exchange protocol that unlocks data for AI training while preserving privacy via compute-to-data and tokenized data assets.

name: NEAR Protocol
description: Sharded, developer-friendly Layer-1 blockchain hosting numerous AI-native projects and user-owned AI agents through its NEAR AI initiative.

name: io.net
description: Decentralized GPU network on Solana that aggregates underutilized GPUs from data centers and consumers to provide affordable compute for AI/ML.

name: Sahara AI
description: Decentralized AI blockchain platform that enables users and developers to build, train, and monetize AI models, agents, and datasets with attribution and ownership.

name: OriginTrail
description: Decentralized knowledge graph (NeuroWeb) that structures trusted data for AI applications, providing verifiable provenance and RAG-ready knowledge assets.

name: Story Protocol
description: Purpose-built Layer-1 blockchain for programmable intellectual property, enabling IP owners to license and monetize their work for AI training and agents.

name: Allora
description: Self-improving decentralized AI network that combines community-built machine learning models to deliver context-aware, secure predictions on-chain.

name: ChainGPT
description: AI infrastructure for Web3 providing LLM-powered smart-contract generation, auditing, AI agents, and an AI model marketplace.

name: Cortex
description: First public blockchain with an on-chain AI inference engine that allows smart contracts to execute AI models directly.

name: Numeraire
description: Ethereum-based hedge fund powered by a global network of data scientists who stake NMR on machine-learning stock predictions.

name: Alethea AI
description: Decentralized protocol for creating intelligent, interactive AI characters (iNFTs) with personality, voice, and generative capabilities on-chain.

name: Botto
description: Decentralized autonomous AI artist whose generative artworks are guided by community votes and auctioned as NFTs on Ethereum.

name: Synesis One
description: Decentralized crowdsourcing platform on Solana that pays users in crypto for generating and labeling training data for AI models.

name: Aethir
description: Decentralized GPU-as-a-service network that aggregates high-end enterprise GPUs to deliver scalable cloud compute for AI and gaming workloads.

name: NetMind Token
description: Decentralized AI compute platform that lets users contribute and rent GPU power for distributed model training, inference, and AI services.

name: PAAL AI
description: AI infrastructure protocol offering custom AI bots, agents, and ML services for crypto communities, plus a launchpad for AI-tokenized projects.

name: KIP Protocol
description: Decentralized Web3 framework for AI that lets creators of AI apps, models, and knowledge bases deploy, connect, and monetize their assets with on-chain rights.

name: Nillion
description: Decentralized secure compute network using blind computation and multi-party computation (MPC) to enable private AI inference on encrypted data.

name: Golem
description: Decentralized peer-to-peer marketplace for buying and selling computing power, used for AI rendering, machine learning, and scientific computations.

name: Aleph Cloud
description: Decentralized off-chain computation, storage, and indexing network that powers AI agents, dApps, and cross-chain messaging without centralized servers.

name: Gensyn
description: Decentralized machine-learning training protocol that uses cryptographic verification to coordinate distributed GPU compute for AI model training.

name: iExec RLC
description: Decentralized cloud computing marketplace leveraging TEE (Intel SGX) for confidential computing, AI inference, and monetizable off-chain assets.

name: Olas
description: Platform for co-owning and coordinating autonomous AI agent services off-chain, with on-chain governance and proof-of-active-agent mechanisms.

name: Morpheus AI
description: Decentralized network for powering smart agents that connect LLMs and AI agents to wallets, dApps, and smart contracts via a peer-to-peer compute layer.

name: Phala Network
description: Decentralized confidential computing cloud using TEE (Intel TDX, NVIDIA H100/H200) to host private AI inference and verifiable AI agents.

name: Nosana
description: Solana-based decentralized GPU marketplace for AI inference and CI/CD workloads, letting node operators monetize idle hardware.

name: Internet Computer
description: Public blockchain that hosts fully on-chain AI inference (e.g., model hosting, AI canisters) and serves as a decentralized compute cloud for smart contracts.

name: Livepeer
description: Decentralized video transcoding network whose GPU marketplace increasingly serves AI inference and generative-media workloads.

name: Theta Network
description: Decentralized video delivery network with a Supercluster of edge GPUs powering AI inference, model training, and next-gen media services.

name: Arweave
description: Permanent, decentralized data storage layer ('permaweb') widely used to host AI training datasets, model weights, and AI-agent outputs.

name: 0G
description: Modular AI-first blockchain combining data availability, storage, and compute layers to verify every AI action on-chain at scale.

name: Grass
description: Decentralized bandwidth-sharing network that scrapes and structures public web data, providing ethical, verifiable datasets for AI model training.

name: Vana
description: Decentralized network of data DAOs that lets users own and pool their private data (e.g., browser, chat, health) to train user-aligned AI models.

name: KAITO
description: AI-powered 'InfoFi' platform that indexes crypto mindshare and delivers AI-augmented search, analytics, and alpha signals across the Web3 ecosystem.

name: Virtuals Protocol
description: Decentralized co-ownership layer on Base for tokenizing revenue-generating AI agents, providing the infrastructure for launching autonomous on-chain agents.

name: Venice
description: Privacy-preserving AI inference platform on Base that offers an uncensored LLM API and uses VVV to stake, govern, and access private compute capacity.

name: ChainOpera AI
description: Blockchain AI operating system for federated AI agents and models, with a decentralized compute + data marketplace and community-driven agent economy.

name: Sentient
description: Open, community-aligned AGI platform building infrastructure for trustworthy AI agents and open-source foundation models with on-chain ownership.

name: Lagrange
description: Cryptographic ground-truth layer for AI and autonomy providing ZK proofs for AI inference and verifiable cross-chain coordination for autonomous systems.

name: AIOZ Network
description: Decentralized CDN and edge-AI compute network that uses DePIN infrastructure for video streaming, AI inference, and distributed machine learning.

name: CARV
description: Modular data layer for AI and gaming that provides on-chain identity, verifiable data, and user-owned data monetization across Web3.

name: EigenLayer
description: Ethereum restaking protocol whose shared security and Actively Validated Services (AVSs) increasingly secure AI compute, data, and inference networks.

name: Sapien
description: Decentralized data-labeling network for AI where contributors earn tokens by providing high-quality human feedback for training foundation models.

name: Uniswap
description: Largest decentralized exchange (DEX) on Ethereum using an automated market maker (AMM) model. Powers trillions in cumulative trading volume with concentrated liquidity (v3) and cross-chain swaps (v4).

name: Aave
description: Open-source, non-custodial liquidity protocol for lending and borrowing crypto assets with variable and stable interest rates. One of the largest DeFi money markets, deploying Aave V3 across Ethereum and L2s, with V4 introducing a modular hub-and-spoke architecture.

name: Sky (formerly MakerDAO)
description: Decentralized lending protocol and largest Ethereum RWA issuer. Evolved from MakerDAO, Sky issues the USDS stablecoin and SKY governance token, and runs the Spark subDAO, managing billions in onchain collateral.

name: Maker
description: Legacy governance token of MakerDAO, the pioneering DeFi lending protocol that created the DAI stablecoin. MKR has been redenominated 1:24,000 into the new SKY token as part of the Endgame rebrand completed in 2025.

name: Curve DAO
description: Decentralized exchange and AMM optimized for efficient stablecoin and pegged-asset trading with low slippage. Curve DAO also issues the crvUSD stablecoin and uses veCRV vote-escrow governance.

name: Compound
description: Algorithmic, autonomous interest rate protocol and one of the original DeFi money markets. Compound v3 (Comet) enables isolated, collateral-backed borrowing of base assets such as USDC.

name: Lido DAO
description: Largest liquid staking protocol for Ethereum, issuing stETH to users who stake ETH without running validators. Lido's staked ETH secures the Ethereum network and is widely integrated across DeFi.

name: Convex Finance
description: Liquidity incentive layer for Curve. Convex lets CRV stakers and Curve liquidity providers earn boosted rewards without locking CRV themselves, and aggregates veCRV governance power.

name: yearn.finance
description: Suite of DeFi yield-aggregation products that auto-route deposits into the highest-yielding strategies across lending, AMMs, and vaults. The YFI token is locked into veYFI for gauge voting.

name: Balancer
description: Programmable liquidity protocol and AMM enabling customizable weighted pools, stable pools, and boosted pools. Balancer V3 powers liquidity infrastructure for many DeFi and RWA markets.

name: Synthetix
description: Decentralized derivatives liquidity protocol providing onchain synthetic assets (perps and synths) via a peer-to-pool model. SNX stakers collateralize the debt pool and earn trading fees.

name: 1inch
description: Leading DEX aggregator that splits and routes orders across hundreds of liquidity sources to deliver optimal swap rates. The 1inch Network also provides a limit-order protocol and the Fusion+ intent-based swaps.

name: Sushi
description: Multi-chain AMM and DeFi ecosystem offering swaps, concentrated liquidity, lending via Kashi, and cross-chain routing via SushiXSwap. SUSHI holders govern the Sushi DAO treasury and fees.

name: PancakeSwap
description: Top decentralized exchange on BNB Smart Chain and other chains, deployed across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, and more. PancakeSwap offers AMM, perpetuals, yield farming, lottery, and an IFO launchpad.

name: dYdX
description: Decentralized perpetuals exchange operating on its own Cosmos SDK-based application chain (dYdX Chain). Offers order-book trading, sub-second finality, and self-custody with the DYDX governance and staking token.

name: GMX
description: Decentralized perpetual exchange on Arbitrum and Avalanche featuring a multi-asset liquidity pool (GLP/GM) model. GMX v2 introduces isolated markets and oracle-based pricing for low-impact trades.

name: Frax
description: Frax Finance is a stablecoin and DeFi protocol suite issuing frxUSD (fully collateralized), FPI (inflation-linked), and frxETH (liquid staking). FXS is the governance and utility token.

name: Rocket Pool
description: Decentralized Ethereum liquid staking protocol that lets anyone run a node with just 8 ETH. rETH is a composable, liquid representation of staked ETH plus rewards, secured by a permissionless network of node operators.

name: Pendle
description: Yield tokenization and trading protocol that splits yield-bearing assets into Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT), enabling fixed yield, yield speculation, and leverage via Boros markets.

name: EigenCloud (EigenLayer)
description: Restaking protocol that lets staked ETH secure additional services (AVSs) and earn extra yield. EigenCloud extends the restaking primitive to verifiable offchain compute, expanding the crypto-economic security surface of Ethereum.

name: Ethena
description: Synthetic dollar protocol issuing USDe, a crypto-native stablecoin backed by delta-hedged ETH and BTC collateral. Also offers sUSDe (staked USDe) and Internet Money (USDtb) for yield generation.

name: Morpho
description: Optimized lending layer on top of Ethereum. Morpho Blue offers permissionless, isolated, peer-to-peer lending markets, while MetaMorpho vaults aggregate Blue markets for curated yield strategies.

name: Spark
description: Institutional-grade onchain capital allocator and a subDAO of Sky. Spark runs SparkLend (Aave V3 fork) and the Spark Liquidity Layer, deploying billions across DeFi, CeFi, and real-world assets for stablecoin yield.

name: Hyperliquid
description: High-performance Layer-1 blockchain purpose-built for onchain perpetual and spot trading. Features a fully onchain order book, HyperBFT consensus, and a native EVM for DeFi composability.

name: Jupiter
description: Leading Solana DEX aggregator and liquidity infrastructure. Jupiter routes swaps across all major Solana AMMs, plus perpetuals (Jupiter Perps), lending, and launchpad products from a unified interface.

name: Raydium
description: Core AMM, CLMM, and liquidity infrastructure on Solana. Raydium provides on-chain market making, yield farming, and an IDO launchpad (AcceleRaytor), and is integrated with both OpenBook and Serum-style CLOBs.

name: Orca
description: Solana's most user-friendly concentrated-liquidity AMM. Orca pioneered Whirlpools, offers fair-price token launches via Aquafarms, and runs the dev-tools platform Sonar.

name: Drift Protocol
description: Onchain perpetuals and spot exchange on Solana featuring a virtual AMM (vAMM) and dynamic AMM (DAMM). Drift offers cross-margin accounts, lending, and liquid staking (LST) within a unified account model.

name: Marinade
description: Solana liquid staking protocol that distributes stake across many validators to maximize decentralization. Issues mSOL (native LST) and LSTs such as MNDE-governed variants, governed by a DAO.

name: Bancor Network
description: Pioneer of the AMM model and one of the first DEXes. Bancor V3 provides single-sided liquidity with impermanent-loss protection and an advanced arbitrator routing engine for onchain token swaps.

name: Kyber Network Crystal
description: Multi-chain DEX aggregator and onchain liquidity protocol. KyberSwap offers limit orders, cross-chain routing, and concentrated-liquidity pools powered by KyberAI, governed by KNC holders.

name: Beefy
description: Multichain, decentralized yield optimizer that automatically compounds LP and lending rewards across 20+ networks. BIFI is the governance token of the Beefy DAO treasury and fee flows.

name: Stargate Finance
description: Composable cross-chain bridge and native asset transfer protocol. Built on LayerZero, Stargate unifies liquidity across chains for fast, guaranteed-finality swaps of native assets.

name: LayerZero
description: Immutable, omnichain messaging protocol that connects 60+ blockchains for lightweight cross-chain message passing. Underpins Stargate, Tapioca, and most modern cross-chain DeFi applications.

name: Wormhole
description: Generic cross-chain messaging protocol with Guardian-secured network. Wormhole connects 30+ chains and powers cross-chain token bridges (Portal), Native Token Transfers (NTT), and multichain DeFi applications.

name: Renzo Protocol
description: Liquid restaking primitive on top of EigenLayer. Renzo aggregates staked ETH (and LSTs) from users and restakes them to secure AVSs, issuing ezETH as the depositable Liquid Restaking Token.

name: Render
description: Render is a decentralized GPU compute marketplace that connects artists, studios, and AI developers with idle GPU capacity for 3D rendering and AI/ML workloads.

name: Helium
description: Helium is a decentralized wireless network that empowers anyone to deploy LoRaWAN and 5G hotspots, providing connectivity for IoT devices and mobile users in exchange for HNT rewards.

name: Arweave
description: Arweave is a permanent, decentralized storage network that allows users to pay once to store data forever using a novel blockweave consensus mechanism and endowment-based incentive model.

name: Livepeer
description: Livepeer is a decentralized video transcoding and streaming network where broadcasters and developers can transcode live and on-demand video at a fraction of traditional cloud cost.

name: IoTeX
description: IoTeX is a modular blockchain platform purpose-built for Real-World AI, providing infrastructure to connect trusted IoT devices and verifiable off-chain data to smart contracts.

name: Akash Network
description: Akash Network is a decentralized cloud computing marketplace built on Cosmos, allowing users to lease idle CPU and GPU capacity through a permissionless, open marketplace.

name: Aleph Cloud
description: Aleph Cloud is a decentralized network of cloud resources providing distributed storage, computing, and confidential VMs, enabling cross-chain dApps and Web3 hosting.

name: Flux
description: Flux is a decentralized Web3 cloud infrastructure powering scalable nodes, dApps, and compute, where operators provide GPU and storage resources in exchange for FLUX rewards.

name: DIMO
description: DIMO is a vehicle data platform that lets drivers stream telemetry from their cars, building a user-owned mobility graph for apps and services in the session-based economy.

name: Hivemapper
description: Hivemapper is a decentralized, AI-powered mapping network where contributors drive with dashcam devices to map the world in real time and earn HONEY tokens.

name: Nodle Network
description: Nodle is a smartphone-based decentralized Bluetooth Low Energy network that turns mobile devices into nodes to provide connectivity, data, and location services for IoT.

name: Mysterium Network
description: Mysterium is a decentralized VPN and Web3 firewall where anyone can share unused bandwidth and earn MYST, providing censorship-resistant, peer-to-peer internet privacy.

name: Streamr
description: Streamr is a peer-to-peer real-time data network that allows producers and consumers to publish, subscribe, and trade live data streams without centralized servers.

name: Crust Network
description: Crust Network is a decentralized cloud storage layer-1 blockchain that enables IPFS pinning and file storage with built-in incentive layer and Meaningful Proof-of-Work consensus.

name: CESS
description: CESS (Cumulus Encrypted Storage System) is a high-speed, secure, and scalable decentralized cloud data storage network built on Substrate for data sovereignty and sharing.

name: Phala Network
description: Phala Network is a decentralized off-chain compute platform using Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) to power confidential AI, sealed agents, and verifiable compute for Web3.

name: Sia
description: Sia is a decentralized peer-to-peer cloud storage network that lets hosts rent out unused hard drive capacity in exchange for Siacoin, replacing centralized cloud providers.

name: Storj
description: Storj is a S3-compatible, end-to-end encrypted decentralized cloud object storage platform where independent node operators earn STORJ for hosting data on the global Tardigrade network.

name: Ankr Network
description: Ankr is a distributed Web3 infrastructure provider offering multi-chain RPC, decentralized node hosting, and liquid staking, rewarding node operators via the ANKR token.

name: Filecoin
description: Filecoin is the largest decentralized storage network, where storage providers earn FIL by proving they are storing cryptographically verified data on behalf of clients.

name: Swarm
description: Swarm is a censorship-resistant, decentralized storage and communication infrastructure for Ethereum, offering redundant data storage with privacy and incentive-driven node participation.

name: PowerPod
description: PowerPod is a DePIN network for community-owned EV charging, allowing anyone to share private EV chargers via a smart adapter and earn rewards in exchange.

name: World Mobile Token
description: World Mobile is a decentralized mobile network leveraging blockchain and shared-economy nodes to bring affordable connectivity to under-served regions across Africa and beyond.

name: Pollen Mobile
description: Pollen Mobile is the first blockchain-based decentralized mobile carrier, rewarding users and node operators with PCN for contributing coverage and infrastructure.

name: MXC / Moonchain
description: MXC (Moonchain) is an Ethereum Layer-3 zkEVM-based DePIN data network using LPWAN technology to match IoT device data with AI models, rewarding participants with MXC tokens.

name: XNET
description: XNET is a decentralized mobile network built on CBRS spectrum and Wi-Fi 6+, allowing operators to deploy community-owned mobile coverage powered by the XNET token.

name: Wicrypt
description: Wicrypt is a decentralized Wi-Fi sharing network where hotspot owners monetize bandwidth and earn WNT, providing affordable internet access in underserved regions.

name: Chirp
description: Chirp is a DePIN ecosystem for IoT, RWA, and telecommunications, rewarding community-run wireless gateways and IoT miners with CHIRP tokens for connectivity and data.

name: WeatherXM
description: WeatherXM is a community-powered weather network that rewards weather station operators with WXM for providing hyperlocal, verified weather data for businesses and consumers.

name: Wayru
description: Wayru is a decentralized Wi-Fi DePIN network that lets anyone deploy hotspots to provide affordable internet and earn WAYRU for sharing connectivity with local communities.

name: Edge Network
description: Edge is a decentralized cloud platform where device owners contribute compute, storage, and bandwidth capacity, paid in EDGE for hosting dApps, CDN, and AI workloads at the edge.

name: ThingsIX
description: ThingsIX is a decentralized LoRaWAN network where gateway operators earn THIX for providing coverage and forwarding packets, enabling open, neutral IoT connectivity worldwide.

name: Iagon
description: Iagon is a decentralized shared compute and storage marketplace built on Cardano, where providers rent out spare storage and CPU to customers and earn IAG.

name: Molecule
description: Decentralized science (DeSci) protocol enabling on-chain funding and coordination of early-stage intellectual property (IP) for research. Molecule's IP-NFT framework lets scientists tokenize research projects, fundraise via DAOs like VitaDAO, and license IP to biotech companies.

name: VitaDAO
description: Decentralized autonomous organization funding early-stage longevity research through IP-NFTs. VitaDAO tokenizes research IP, lets VITA holders govern funding, and partners with Molecule to translate academic science into therapies targeting aging and age-related disease.

name: GenomesDAO
description: Privacy-preserving, user-owned genomic data platform. GenomesDAO lets individuals store DNA and biomedical data encrypted on-chain, control access, and monetize it for research while earning rewards via the GENE token.

name: Bio Protocol
description: DeSci liquidity and coordination layer for on-chain biotech. Bio Protocol uses the BIO token to power a network of BioDAOs funding decentralized research, offering launchpad infrastructure, staking, and shared liquidity across the DeSci ecosystem.

name: ResearchHub
description: Web3 platform that rewards scientists for publishing, peer-reviewing, and curating academic work. ResearchHub distributes RSC tokens for open science contributions and aims to create a decentralized alternative to traditional scientific publishing.

name: Cere Network
description: Decentralized data cloud for enterprise and consumer applications, including scientific data management. Cere provides a Polkadot-based DDSM (Decentralized Data Management System) used by DAOs and Web3 organizations to store and control research data.

name: dClimate
description: Decentralized network for climate and environmental data. dClimate aggregates, validates, and distributes open climate datasets, smart-contract weather derivatives, and APIs that researchers and DeSci projects use to build climate models and forecasts.

name: IPFS (Protocol Labs)
description: InterPlanetary File System is a peer-to-peer hypermedia protocol addressing content by hash. Developed by Protocol Labs alongside Filecoin, IPFS is foundational infrastructure for decentralized science, enabling censorship-resistant storage of large research datasets.

name: Filecoin
description: Decentralized storage network that turns cloud storage into an open marketplace. Filecoin is widely used by DeSci and open-science projects to archive large datasets (genomic, climate, microscopy) with cryptographic proofs of storage.

name: OriginTrail
description: Decentralized knowledge graph for supply chains and trusted data. OriginTrail v6 (NeuroWeb) builds verifiable, AI-ready data infrastructure used by science and healthcare ecosystems to trace provenance, integrity, and licensing of research data.

name: Ocean Protocol
description: Decentralized data exchange protocol that unlocks data for AI and research while preserving privacy. Ocean's 'Compute-to-Data' lets scientists train models on datasets (e.g., biomedical, climate) without the data ever leaving the owner's control.

name: The Graph
description: Indexing and query layer for blockchains, often called the 'Google of Web3'. The Graph is used by DeSci dashboards (VitaDAO, Ocean, Bio Protocol) to query on-chain research funding, governance, and IP-NFT data via open subgraphs.

name: PowerPool
description: Decentralized governance and on-chain asset management protocol. PowerPool lets users pool governance power, automate treasury operations, and execute DeFi strategies—often used by DeSci DAOs to manage research treasuries and votes.

name: Gitcoin
description: Decentralized quadratic-funding protocol for public goods. Gitcoin Grants has directed tens of millions of dollars to open-source, climate, and DeSci projects, with the GTC token governing the Gitcoin DAO and funding decisions.

name: Giveth
description: Decentralized giving and donation platform using quadratic funding. Giveth lets donors fund nonprofits, open-source, and DeSci public goods with full on-chain transparency, and routes GIV governance over the DApp and the Giveth DAO.

name: Kleros
description: Decentralized court protocol using Schelling-game juries to adjudicate disputes. Kleros is used by DAOs, including DeSci communities, to resolve disputes over funding, IP licensing, peer review, and curation of open research data.

name: Aragon
description: Framework for building and operating decentralized autonomous organizations on Ethereum. Aragon OSx powers many DeSci and BioDAOs with modular on-chain governance, treasuries, and plugins for managing research funding and IP.

name: Colony
description: On-chain reputation and collaboration framework for open organizations. Colony's reputation-weighted governance, payments, and tasks are used by research collectives and DeSci DAOs to coordinate contributor rewards transparently.

name: AthenaDAO
description: Decentralized research collective funding women's health and reproductive science. AthenaDAO pools capital, IP-NFTs research projects, and distributes research outputs to the public while ATH holders govern the treasury and grants.

name: LabDAO
description: Decentralized biotech collective building open-source tools for computational biology. LabDAO operates PLEX (a peer-to-peer compute marketplace for AlphaFold, molecular dynamics, and more) and uses IP-NFTs to coordinate research IP.

name: Bio.xyz
description: Launchpad and coordination layer for BioDAOs running on Bio Protocol. Bio.xyz (formerly Molecule Catalyst) helps scientific communities spin up tokenized funding vehicles, IP-NFTs, and on-chain research workflows.

name: HyperCerts
description: Tokenized, portable claims on intellectual, scientific, and social contributions. Hypercerts (built by Hypercerts Foundation) lets researchers and public-good contributors issue verifiable, on-chain impact claims and trade or fund them.

name: Data Lake
description: Decentralized platform for consent-based medical and scientific data sharing. Data Lake lets patients and research participants control access to health records and earn from studies that use their data, with on-chain consent receipts.

name: SorcererDAO
description: DeSci community DAO funding and coordinating open scientific research, including longevity and biotech projects. SorcererDAO builds tooling for on-chain research collaboration and connects BioDAOs across the DeSci ecosystem.

name: ValleyDAO
description: Decentralized community funding synthetic biology and engineering biology research. ValleyDAO uses IP-NFTs to tokenize scientific IP and GROW for governance, with a focus on open, public-good outcomes in life sciences.

name: PsyDAO
description: Decentralized collective funding psychedelic and mental-health research. PsyDAO finances clinical and scientific work into psychedelic-assisted therapies, coordinates IP-NFTs, and lets PSY holders govern research priorities.

name: HairDAO
description: Decentralized research DAO focused on hair-loss treatments and dermatology. HairDAO funds peer-reviewed research, licenses IP via IP-NFTs, and uses the HAIR token to coordinate its scientific and treasury operations.

name: CryoDAO
description: Cryopreservation research DAO funding the science of reversible cryopreservation and biostasis. CryoDAO channels CRYO governance over a portfolio of research projects, including IP-NFTs and academic grants in low-temperature biology.

name: AntiHaus
description: DeSci community focused on decentralized peer review, scientific publishing, and reproducibility. AntiHaus builds open tools to challenge the credibility and incentive structure of traditional scientific journals.

name: MoonDAO
description: Decentralized space program funding space research, exploration, and science. MoonDAO has sent members to space via Blue Origin, funds open-space-research grants, and uses the MOONEY token to coordinate the world's largest 'space DAO'.

name: Axie Infinity
description: Axie Infinity is a blockchain-based play-to-earn MMO game where players collect, breed, raise, battle, and trade token-based creatures known as Axies. Built on the Ronin sidechain by Sky Mavis, it pioneered the GameFi model with a dual-token economy (AXS and SLP).

name: The Sandbox
description: The Sandbox is a user-generated content (UGC) gaming metaverse that empowers creators through digital ownership and monetization of 3D voxel creations. Players can build, play, and monetize gaming experiences using NFTs and the SAND utility token on Ethereum.

name: Decentraland
description: Decentraland is a decentralized virtual world built on Ethereum where users can create, experience, and monetize content and applications. Land (LAND) and the in-world currency MANA power a fully user-owned 3D metaverse governed by a DAO.

name: Enjin Coin
description: Enjin is a leading blockchain ecosystem for NFTs, offering a suite of products for creating, trading, distributing, and integrating non-fungible tokens into virtual worlds. ENJ is the native coin of the Enjin Blockchain used to mint, back, and transfer NFT assets across games.

name: Gala
description: Gala is a blockchain gaming ecosystem operating on its own GalaChain L1, founded by Gala Games. It powers a network of play-to-earn and play-and-own titles (Town Star, Spider Tanks, Last Expedition, etc.) with GALA used for governance, in-game purchases, and node operations.

name: Immutable
description: Immutable is a Layer-2 scaling network and ecosystem focused on Web3 gaming, with the IMX token used for fees, staking, and governance. It powers major titles such as Gods Unchained, Illuvium, Guild of Guardians, and Ember Sword on its zkEVM stack.

name: Illuvium
description: Illuvium is a franchise of interconnected AAA blockchain games (Overworld, Arena, Zero, Beyond) developed by Illuvium Labs, featuring an open-world creature-collection autobattler with fully on-chain liquidity for NFT assets and the ILV governance/yield token.

name: My Neighbor Alice
description: My Neighbor Alice is a multiplayer builder game inspired by Animal Crossing and Minecraft, where players buy and customize virtual islands, farm, fish, and socialize. Built on Chromia, it uses the ALICE token for in-game economy and governance.

name: Star Atlas
description: Star Atlas is a space-faring grand strategy MMO built on Solana with Unreal Engine 5 graphics, where players can explore, fight, mine, and trade across factions. ATLAS and POLIS dual-token economy power the in-game economy, with deep NFT-based land and ship ownership.

name: Gods Unchained
description: Gods Unchained is a free-to-play tactical trading card game developed by Immutable, where every card is a true NFT owned by the player. Players build decks of mythic gods and creatures to battle in ranked PvP, with GODS used for crafting, tournaments, and governance.

name: Yield Guild Games
description: Yield Guild Games is a DAO focused on investing in NFTs used in virtual worlds and play-to-earn blockchain games, managing scholarship programs across Axie Infinity, Otherside, Big Time, and many other GameFi titles. YGG is the governance and staking token.

name: Big Time
description: Big Time is a free-to-play multiplayer action RPG where players adventure through time and space, collect NFT gear, craft weapons, and battle in dungeons. Built by Big Time Studios, it features player-owned cosmetics and the BIGTIME token for governance and in-game upgrades.

name: WAX
description: WAX (Worldwide Asset eXchange) is a purpose-built, carbon-neutral Layer-1 blockchain optimized for gaming, NFTs, and digital collectibles. It hosts thousands of NFT games and virtual items and powers marketplaces such as AtomicHub and NFTHive.

name: Ultra
description: Ultra is a Layer-1 blockchain gaming platform built on a fork of EOSIO that offers zero gas fees, a unified game launcher, esports tournaments, and a creator marketplace. UOS powers transactions, staking, and governance across the Ultra ecosystem.

name: ApeCoin
description: ApeCoin is the native gas and governance token of the ApeCoin DAO and ApeChain, an EVM-equivalent chain built for Web3 gaming, NFTs, and culture. Originating from the Bored Ape Yacht Club ecosystem, APE powers the Otherside metaverse and hundreds of community-built games.

name: Beam
description: Beam is a sovereign Layer-1 blockchain specialized for gaming, developed by Merit Circle DAO (formerly known as Merit Circle / MC). It offers a built-in account abstraction stack, low gas, and a unified marketplace for in-game assets, with BEAM as the native gas and governance token.

name: Ronin
description: Ronin is an EVM-compatible sidechain originally built by Sky Mavis specifically for Axie Infinity, now home to many Web3 games including Pixels, Apeiron, and Tribes. RON is the native gas and staking token securing the network's delegated proof-of-stake consensus.

name: Treasure
description: Treasure is a decentralized gaming and AI-agent ecosystem on Arbitrum, where MAGIC is the native currency that bridges multiple metaverses and NFT games (Bridgeworld, Smolworld, Realm, etc.). It is now evolving into an AI agent infrastructure network with MAGIC as the coordination layer.

name: SuperVerse
description: SuperVerse (formerly SuperFarm) is a Web3 entertainment ecosystem that integrates decentralized finance, NFTs, and gaming, with SUPER used as the utility, governance, and bridging token across its titles, marketplace, and the SuperVerse game launcher.

name: X2Y2
description: X2Y2 is a community-driven, fully decentralized NFT marketplace that pioneered bulk listings, advanced on-chain orders, and a buy-now-pay-later feature. The X2Y2 token is used for governance and fee discounts across the protocol (now operated in maintenance mode).

name: Heroes of Mavia
description: Heroes of Mavia is a mobile Web3 MMO strategy game developed by Skrice Studios where players build bases, train armies, and battle rival players for the in-game RUBY token. MAVIA is the governance and staking token of the Mavia ecosystem on Base.

name: Pixels
description: Pixels is an open-world farming and social MMO that migrated to the Ronin network and now operates as one of the most active Web3 games by user count. Players farm, craft, and complete quests to earn PIXEL, the ecosystem's native token.

name: Portal
description: Portal is a cross-chain gaming platform (LayerX Labs) that connects hundreds of Web3 games and lets players use one identity, wallet, and token across them. PORTAL is the native utility token of the Portal platform and powers the in-game economies it bridges.

name: PlayDapp
description: PlayDapp is a Korean-founded Web3 gaming infrastructure platform that provides a C2C NFT marketplace, an SDK for game tokenization, and a play-to-earn ecosystem. PDA (formerly PLA after a re-issuance incident) is the platform's main utility and governance token.

name: Voxies
description: Voxies (Voxie Tactics) is a free-to-play 3D turn-based tactical RPG inspired by Final Fantasy Tactics, built on Polygon with NFT-based Voxie characters. VOXEL is the in-game utility token used for crafting, upgrades, rentals, and Battlegrounds PvP mode.

name: Alien Worlds
description: Alien Worlds is a community-built, cross-chain metaverse game where players explore planets, mine Trilium (TLM), compete for Planet DAOs, and earn NFTs. It is one of the most long-running and highest-volume GameFi dApps, deployed across WAX, Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Polygon.

name: Sweat Economy
description: Sweat Economy is the Web3 evolution of the Sweatcoin move-to-earn app, where over 150 million users earn SWEAT tokens for physical activity verified by smartphone oracles. The token is issued on NEAR and bridged to Ethereum and other chains.

name: STEPN
description: STEPN is a Web3 lifestyle app with built-in Social-Fi and Game-Fi elements by Find Satoshi Lab, where users buy NFT Sneakers and earn tokens by walking, jogging, or running outdoors. GMT is the governance and treasury token of the ecosystem alongside the spendable GST token.

name: GAMEE
description: GAMEE is a Telegram- and mobile-first casual gaming platform by Animoca Brands subsidiary Gamee, with 80+ lightweight titles (Arc8, WatSight, etc.) and a tokenized ad network. GMEE is the ERC-20 utility token used for access, action, and governance across the ecosystem.

name: Tamadoge
description: Tamadoge is a meme-coin gaming project that combines Tamagotchi-style virtual pet NFT gameplay (mint, breed, battle) with a P2E arcade, originally launched via a successful presale in 2022. TAMA is the native utility token of the Tamaverse ecosystem.

name: Calvaria: Duels of Eternity
description: Calvaria: Duels of Eternity is a play-to-earn battle-card strategy game on Polygon where players collect and battle with NFT cards in a game set beyond the veil of death. RIA is the main in-game currency used to acquire, trade, and upgrade NFT card assets.

name: Nifty Island
description: Nifty Island is an open, user-generated-content gaming platform on Ethereum and LayerZero-compatible chains where communities create and play mini-games on customizable islands. ISLAND is the platform's governance and reward token.

name: Sipher
description: Sipher (Sipher Odyssey) is a fast-paced multiplayer action roguelite RPG set inside the Sipher universe, developed by Ather Labs. SIPHER is the governance and in-game currency of the Sipher ecosystem, originally launched on Ethereum and now multichain.

name: BLOCKLORDS
description: BLOCKLORDS is a player-driven grand-strategy medieval MMO developed by MetaKing Studios, with play-to-own mechanics where every hero, land, and resource is an NFT. LRDS is the governance and economic token of the BLOCKLORDS economy.

name: Shrapnel
description: Shrapnel is a AAA moddable, UGC-driven extraction shooter on Avalanche developed by Neon Machine (ex-Bungie, 343, Halo veterans). SHRAP is the in-game ERC-20 currency for buying, selling, and monetizing player-created content and assets.

name: Moca Network
description: Moca Network is Animoca Brands' identity and consumer-app chain powering Moca ID across 450+ portfolio companies and partner gaming ecosystems. MOCA is the omni-chain governance and utility token of the network, leveraging LayerZero OFT standard.

name: CARV
description: CARV is an AI-native, modular chain ecosystem for sovereign AI agents and data sovereignty, integrating with 1,000+ Web3 games via its CARV ID D.A.T.A. framework. CARV is the governance and incentive token for verifiers, agents, and ecosystem participants.

name: PLEARN
description: PLEARN is a play-to-earn GameFi project that combines casual puzzle and arcade-style mini-games with on-chain rewards, designed to onboard mass-market users into Web3. PLN is the native utility token used for rewards, governance, and ecosystem incentives.

name: Midas Miner
description: Midas Miner is a play-to-earn gold-mining game on BNB Smart Chain where players collect NFT miners, upgrade them, and earn MMI tokens passively. MMI is the BEP-20 utility token of the Midas Miner game economy.

name: Cradles: Origin of Species
description: Cradles: Origin of Species is a prehistoric-era MMORPG developed by DRepublic Labs where players hunt, craft, and own NFT-based weapons, relics, and land. CRDS is the native governance and in-game currency of the Cradles metaverse on Polygon.

name: Kingdom Karnage
description: Kingdom Karnage is a cross-platform, animated-combat trading card game developed by Kepithor Studios, originally built on Enjin's JumpNet and now multichain. KKT is the in-game utility token for buying card packs, upgrading heroes, and tournament rewards.

name: Chainlink
description: Decentralized oracle network providing tamper-proof inputs, outputs, and computations to support advanced smart contracts on any blockchain.

name: The Graph
description: Decentralized indexing protocol for organizing and querying blockchain data through open APIs called subgraphs.

name: Filecoin
description: Peer-to-peer network that enables anyone to store and retrieve data on the internet through an open, decentralized storage marketplace.

name: Arweave
description: Permanent, decentralized information storage network (permaweb) backed by a one-time-fee endowment model for durable data archiving.

name: Pocket Network
description: Decentralized RPC infrastructure network providing reliable, self-healing access to 30+ public blockchains and Layer-2 networks.

name: Ankr
description: Web3 infrastructure provider offering multi-chain RPC services, advanced APIs, liquid staking, and app-chain (Supernet) deployment.

name: iExec RLC
description: Decentralized cloud computing protocol providing confidential computing, off-chain data, and programmable privacy for Web3 applications.

name: Covalent
description: Modular data infrastructure layer delivering a unified API for indexed, verifiable historical and real-time data across 100+ blockchains.

name: Subsquid (SQD)
description: Open data platform for Web3 providing decentralized data lake and ETL toolkit for indexing 225+ chains, supported by worker, gateway, and scheduler nodes.

name: Cartesi
description: First operating system on the blockchain, bridging mainstream software and decentralized apps with Linux runtime and RISC-V Cartesi Machine.

name: SKALE
description: Ethereum-native multichain network of high-throughput, gas-free application-specific blockchains anchored to Ethereum and Base.

name: API3
description: Decentralized API network connecting smart contracts directly with first-party oracles operated by API providers, governed by API3 DAO.

name: DIA
description: Open-source oracle platform providing transparent, verifiable, and customizable financial data feeds for DeFi and Web3 across 25+ chains.

name: Space and Time
description: Decentralized data blockchain (SXT Chain) serving as a verifiable data warehouse and ZK coprocessor for SQL queries over onchain and offchain data.

name: Polyhedra Network
description: Zero-knowledge proof infrastructure powering zkBridge interoperability, EXPchain, and zk-SNARK libraries for cross-chain and verifiable computation.

name: Wormhole
description: Generic cross-chain messaging protocol enabling transfer of tokens, data, and arbitrary messages across 30+ blockchains.

name: LayerZero
description: Immutable, permissionless omnichain messaging protocol connecting 60+ blockchains for trustless cross-chain applications and asset transfers.

name: Across Protocol
description: Optimistic cross-chain bridge protocol enabling fast, low-cost asset transfers between EVM networks secured by a single HubPool on Ethereum.

name: Hyperlane
description: Permissionless interoperability protocol for interchain messaging with sovereign consensus and modular security across 150+ chains.

name: Celestia
description: First modular blockchain network providing scalable data availability and consensus as a service, enabling rollups and sovereign appchains.

name: Avail
description: Modular blockchain unifying data availability, validity proof aggregation, and cross-chain messaging through Avail Nexus for the multi-chain ecosystem.

name: EigenCloud (EigenLayer)
description: Ethereum restaking protocol that lets staked ETH and LSTs secure new services (AVSs) and verifiable applications via EigenCloud.

name: Symbiotic
description: Permissionless shared-security protocol enabling networks to coordinate collateral markets, slashing, and restaking without protocol-level trust assumptions.

name: Nillion
description: Secure computation network using blind computation and nilVM to decentralize trust for high-value data, bridging to Ethereum as an L2.

name: Aethir
description: Distributed enterprise-grade GPU cloud infrastructure aggregating 440,000+ GPU containers across 90+ countries for AI, gaming, and Web3 workloads.

name: io.net
description: Decentralized GPU network aggregating idle consumer and data-center GPUs (H100, A100) for distributed AI/ML compute on Solana.

name: AltLayer
description: Restaked rollups-as-a-service platform extending EigenLayer restaking to launch and operate scalable, application-dedicated execution layers.

name: Fleek Network
description: Decentralized edge platform for deploying and running highly performant, censorship-resistant web services with a censorship-resistant CDN layer.

name: Spheron Network
description: Community-powered DePIN compute network turning idle consumer hardware (GPUs and CPUs) into a global, affordable AI workload data center.

name: Ocean Protocol
description: Web3 data and AI ecosystem enabling privacy-preserving publishing, exchange, and monetization of data, models, and compute services.

name: OriginTrail
description: Decentralized Knowledge Graph (DKG) infrastructure for multi-agent AI memory, supply-chain provenance, and verifiable knowledge at internet scale.

name: Livepeer
description: Open-source, decentralized video infrastructure network for transcoding, live streaming, and AI-driven real-time video processing.

name: Tellor Tributes
description: Decentralized, censorship-resistant oracle protocol using a Cosmos SDK Layer 1 (Tellor Layer) to bring any subjective data onchain.

name: Umbrella Network
description: Community-owned Layer 2 oracle providing decentralized, low-cost, and comprehensive data feeds for DeFi; oracle product operations ceased September 30, 2025.

name: Stargate Finance
description: Composable native-asset bridge with unified liquidity and instant guaranteed finality built on the LayerZero omnichain messaging protocol.

name: Band Protocol (Band)
description: Cross-chain data oracle platform aggregating and connecting real-world data and APIs to smart contracts and AI engines via BandChain.

name: Bitcoin
description: Первая децентрализованная криптовалюта, использующая блокчейн для одноранговых транзакций.

name: Ethereum
description: Децентрализованная платформа смарт-контрактов с собственной криптовалютой Ether.

name: Solana
description: Высокопроизводительный блокчейн с высокой пропускной способностью и низкими комиссиями.

name: Avalanche
description: Платформа смарт-контрактов с поддержкой пользовательских блокчейнов (сабнетов).

name: Polkadot
description: Мультичейн-платформа, объединяющая специализированные парачейны в единую защищённую сеть.

name: Cosmos Hub
description: Экосистема независимых блокчейнов, взаимодействующих через протокол IBC (Inter-Blockchain Communication).

name: Near Protocol
description: Масштабируемый блокчейн с шардингом и удобной моделью для разработчиков.

name: Aptos
description: Высокопроизводительный блокчейн нового поколения на языке программирования Move.

name: Sui
description: Объектно-ориентированный блокчейн с параллельным исполнением транзакций.

name: Sei
description: Высокопроизводительный Layer 1, оптимизированный для торговых приложений и DeFi.

name: Internet Computer
description: Децентрализованная облачная платформа для хостинга смарт-контрактов на уровне протокола.

name: Tezos
description: Блокчейн с механизмом самостоятельного обновления протокола без форков.

name: Algorand
description: Блокчейн на основе чистого доказательства доли с мгновенной финализацией транзакций.

name: Hedera
description: Распределённый реестр на основе хэшграфа с высокой пропускной способностью и управлением от крупных корпораций.

name: Stellar
description: Сеть для быстрых и недорогих международных платежей и токенизации активов.

name: Tron
description: Децентрализованная платформа для развлекательного контента и DeFi-приложений.

name: Cardano
description: Блокчейн с рецензируемой академической разработкой и формальной верификацией.

name: Filecoin
description: Децентрализованная сеть хранения данных с криптоэкономическими стимулами.

name: MultiversX
description: Масштабируемый блокчейн с адаптивным шардингом для высокой пропускной способности.

name: Injective
description: Блокчейн, оптимизированный для децентрализованных финансов и торговли деривативами.

name: Celestia
description: Модульный блокчейн, разделяющий консенсус и исполнение для достижения масштабируемости.

name: Monad
description: EVM-совместимый Layer 1 с параллельным исполнением и высокой пропускной способностью.

name: Berachain
description: EVM-совместимый блокчейн с уникальным консенсусом Proof of Liquidity и моделью tri-token.

name: Sonic
description: Высокопроизводительный EVM-блокчейн с мгновенной финализацией (преемник Fantom от Sonic Labs).

name: Fantom
description: DAG-ориентированный блокчейн с быстрыми транзакциями и низкими комиссиями.

name: Cronos
description: EVM-совместимый блокчейн, разработанный Crypto.com, для DeFi и платежей.

name: Kava
description: Блокчейн с поддержкой как EVM, так и Cosmos SDK для гибридных приложений.

name: Oasis Network
description: Масштабируемый блокчейн с поддержкой конфиденциальных вычислений через TEE.

name: Mina Protocol
description: Самый лёгкий блокчейн с постоянным размером благодаря рекурсивным zk-SNARK.

name: Initia
description: Модульный Layer 1, объединяющий экосистему Omnichain-приложений с единой ликвидностью.

name: Toncoin
description: Децентрализованная сеть, изначально разработанная командой Telegram, для массовых Web3-приложений.

name: Kaspa
description: Блокчейн с протоколом GhostDAG для высокой пропускной способности и мгновной финализации.

name: XRP
description: Распределённый реестр XRP Ledger для быстрых и недорогих международных платежей.

name: EOS
description: Платформа смарт-контрактов с моделью делегированного доказательства доли (DPoS).

name: NEO
description: Китайский блокчейн с поддержкой цифровых активов, смарт-контрактов и цифровой идентификации.

name: Flow
description: Блокчейн, разработанный для NFT, игр и развлекательных приложений с архитектурой multi-role.

name: Conflux
description: Китайский блокчейн с Tree-Graph структурой для высокой пропускной способности и совместимости с Ethereum.

name: BNB
description: Блокчейн BNB Chain (бывш. BSC) от Binance, EVM-совместимый с высокой пропускной способностью.

name: Dogecoin
description: Оригинальная мем-монета, развившаяся в самостоятельный блокчейн с активным сообществом.

name: Litecoin
description: Один из первых форков Bitcoin, ориентированный на быстрые и дешёвые транзакции.

name: IOTA
description: Распределённый реестр на основе технологии Tangle (DAG), ориентированный на IoT.

name: Zilliqa
description: Один из первых блокчейнов с практической реализацией шардинга для высокой пропускной способности.

name: Kadena
description: Масштабируемый блокчейн с архитектурой Chainweb для параллельных цепей и Pact-смарт-контрактами.

name: Arbitrum
description: Arbitrum is a leading Ethereum optimistic rollup L2 that offers high-throughput, low-cost smart contract execution while inheriting Ethereum's security.

name: Optimism
description: Optimism is an Ethereum L2 optimistic rollup and the core of the OP Stack ecosystem powering the Superchain of interoperable L2s.

name: Polygon
description: Polygon is an EVM-compatible scaling platform and aggregation layer for Ethereum, combining PoS, zkEVM and AggLayer interoperability.

name: zkSync
description: ZKsync is an EVM-compatible ZK rollup on Ethereum that scales transactions and smart contracts with zero-knowledge proofs and native account abstraction.

name: Starknet
description: Starknet is a validity rollup (ZK-STARK) L2 on Ethereum that enables scalable, low-cost smart contract execution using STARK proofs.

name: Mantle
description: Mantle is a high-performance Ethereum L2 combining an optimistic rollup architecture with modular data availability (EigenDA) and a growing treasury.

name: Blast
description: Blast is an EVM-compatible optimistic rollup on Ethereum offering native yield on ETH and stablecoin balances through automated T-bill and validator staking strategies.

name: Manta Network
description: Manta Network is a modular ZK L2 ecosystem providing scalable, privacy-preserving and EVM-compatible infrastructure for decentralized applications.

name: Immutable
description: Immutable is a gaming-focused Ethereum L2 zk-rollup delivering high-throughput, gas-free trading of in-game NFTs and digital assets.

name: Loopring
description: Loopring is a ZK rollup protocol on Ethereum; its L2 operator was sunset in 2025 with the codebase remaining as a reference for ZK-rollup-based DEXs and payments.

name: Metis
description: Metis is an Ethereum optimistic rollup L2 focused on DAO infrastructure, decentralized sequencers and Hybrid Compute for Web3 businesses.

name: Boba Network
description: Boba Network is an OP-Stack-based Ethereum L2 that extends smart contracts with Hybrid Compute to call off-chain web APIs and AI/ML services.

name: Aurora
description: Aurora is an EVM-compatible execution environment running as a smart contract on the NEAR Protocol, providing Ethereum-like L2 performance with NEAR-grade scalability.

name: Zircuit
description: Zircuit is an AI-powered, EVM-compatible ZK-optimistic hybrid rollup L2 focused on sequencer-level security and automated threat protection.

name: Gnosis
description: Gnosis Chain is a community-owned EVM L1 (scaling Ethereum with a unique dual-token model) running as a highly decentralized sidechain for payments and DeFi.

name: Celo
description: Celo is a mobile-first, carbon-negative EVM blockchain that transitioned to an OP Stack L2 on Ethereum, focused on real-world payments and financial inclusion.

name: Klaytn
description: Klaytn (now merged into the Kaia network) is a high-performance, BFT-based EVM-compatible blockchain optimized for metaverse, gaming and enterprise use cases.

name: Moonbeam
description: Moonbeam is a smart-contract parachain on Polkadot that provides full Ethereum compatibility and cross-chain connectivity via XCM.

name: Astar
description: Astar Network is a dApp hub parachain on Polkadot supporting EVM and WASM smart contracts with native ZK and DeFi infrastructure.

name: SKALE
description: SKALE is an elastic sidechain network of Ethereum-native, high-throughput, zero-gas-fee application-specific chains secured by a pooled validator set.

name: ZetaChain
description: ZetaChain is a universal EVM L1 enabling omnichain smart contracts and native cross-chain messaging between Bitcoin, Ethereum and other major chains.

name: Linea
description: Linea is a developer-ready, EVM-equivalent ZK L2 by Consensys that scales Ethereum with strong security guarantees and a thriving consumer and DeFi ecosystem.

name: Scroll
description: Scroll is a bytecode-equivalent zkEVM L2 on Ethereum that uses zero-knowledge proofs to scale smart contracts without compromising on EVM compatibility.

name: Mode
description: Mode is an OP-Stack L2 optimized for growth, rewarding developers and users with sequencer revenue sharing for the apps they build and use.

name: Superchain
description: Superchain is the Optimism Collective's network of horizontally-scaled OP Stack L2s sharing a unified sequencing, security and bridge layer (represented by the OP token).

name: opBNB
description: opBNB is an OP-Stack-based optimistic rollup L2 on top of BNB Smart Chain, offering higher throughput and lower fees for BNB Chain applications.

name: Kakarot
description: Kakarot is a zkEVM implemented in Cairo and (acquired by Zama in 2025) provides a STARK-proved EVM execution environment and a proving engine for Ethereum and Starknet apps.

name: Aevo
description: Aevo is a high-performance decentralized derivatives exchange running on its own OP-Stack L2 focused on options, perps and structured products.

name: Lyra
description: Lyra is an OP-Stack-based L2 (now part of the Derive ecosystem) that hosts spot and derivatives liquidity with a unified orderbook and matching engine.

name: Polynomial
description: Polynomial is an OP-Stack-powered L2 exchange for perpetual futures, built for low latency, deep liquidity and MEV-resistant on-chain order matching.

name: Zora
description: Zora is an OP-Stack L2 optimized for on-chain media, enabling creators to mint, trade and discover NFTs and social tokens with low fees and fast finality.

name: Lisk
description: Lisk is an OP-Stack L2 (rebranded from its L1 origin) that provides a low-cost platform for real-world Web3 applications, especially in emerging markets.

name: Karura
description: Karura is a canary-network DeFi hub on Kusama (Acala's sister network) offering a stablecoin, liquid staking and an AMM for early-stage dApp experimentation.

name: Ondo Finance
description: Institutional-grade DeFi platform tokenizing US Treasuries, money market funds, and traditional securities (bonds, stocks) into on-chain financial products such as OUSG, USDY, and Ondo Global Markets.

name: Maker / Sky Protocol
description: Decentralized lending and stablecoin protocol (formerly MakerDAO, rebranded to Sky in 2024) issuing the DAI/USDS stablecoin backed heavily by tokenized US Treasuries and other real-world assets via the RWA Vaults.

name: Centrifuge
description: Purpose-built infrastructure for onchain asset management and tokenization of real-world assets (invoices, receivables, private credit), featuring the Centrifuge Chain (Altair) and Tinlake/JVMs pools.

name: Maple Finance
description: On-chain institutional lending marketplace offering undercollateralized loans to vetted institutional borrowers, with the SYRUP token extending fixed-income yield to DeFi users.

name: Goldfinch
description: Decentralized credit protocol that provides undercollateralized loans to real-world businesses in emerging markets, with Goldfinch Prime giving access to private credit funds from Ares, Apollo and others.

name: TrueFi
description: DeFi uncollateralized lending protocol developed by the TrustToken / Archblock team, using on-chain credit scores to deliver predictable loan terms for vetted borrowers.

name: Clearpool
description: Decentralized capital markets ecosystem where institutional borrowers access unsecured liquidity from a pool of lenders, with the CPOOL token securing the protocol as a tokenization engine for the onchain economy.

name: Polymesh
description: Institutional-grade, permissioned blockchain built specifically for regulated assets, security tokens, and real-world assets, with native identity, compliance and confidential asset primitives.

name: Digix (DGX / DGD)
description: Pioneering gold-backed tokenization protocol on Ethereum where each DGX represents 1 gram of physical gold held in vaults; one of the earliest RWA projects (originally paired with the DigixDAO DGD governance token).

name: PAX Gold (Paxos)
description: Regulated ERC-20 token issued by Paxos Trust Company where one PAXG represents one fine troy ounce of an LBMA-accredited London Good Delivery gold bar stored in professional vaults.

name: Tether Gold (XAUT)
description: Digital token issued by Tether that represents ownership of one troy ounce of physical gold held in a Swiss vault, offering 24/7 transferability and divisibility on-chain.

name: Realio Network
description: Layer-1 EVM-compatible Cosmos SDK blockchain for the issuance, management and trading of digitally native Real-World Assets, including real estate, private equity and tokenized funds.

name: Plume Network
description: Modular L1/L2 blockchain purpose-built for real-world assets (RWAfi), offering a full-stack platform for tokenization, distribution and on-chain management of RWAs.

name: M^0 (M Zero)
description: Modular stablecoin infrastructure that lets approved institutions mint a shared base-dollar token ($M) against high-quality liquid assets (e.g. T-bills) and distribute yield to a network of yield earners.

name: Usual (Usual Money)
description: Decentralized fiat-backed stablecoin issuer that redistributes ownership, governance and revenue of tokenized real-world assets (USD0 backed by US Treasury Bills) to the community via the USUAL token.

name: Mountain Protocol
description: Bermuda-regulated issuer of USDM, a permissionless yield-bearing stablecoin fully backed by short-term US Treasury bills (acquired by Anchorage Digital with USDM in orderly wind-down).

name: BlackRock BUIDL Fund
description: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund - the world's largest asset manager's first tokenized fund issued on a public blockchain (Ethereum, then Solana, Arbitrum, etc.) via Securitize.

name: Securitize
description: Leading end-to-end tokenization platform and transfer agent (now publicly listed on NYSE) powering BUIDL and many other regulated digital securities, with the Digital Securities (DS) Protocol for onchain compliance.

name: Credix
description: Solana-based decentralized credit marketplace that tokenizes and securitizes the private credit market, connecting investors with FinTech lenders in emerging markets.

name: LendOS
description: Capital-efficient decentralized lending operating system on Neon EVM and Hemi, focusing on LP-tokenized lending and onchain RWA-collateralized markets.

name: Midas
description: On-chain asset tokenization protocol turning institutional strategies (e.g. short-dated US Treasury Bills via mTBILL) into composable, compliant ERC-20 tokens usable across DeFi.

name: Credmark
description: Financial-modeling platform for DeFi providing risk models powered by verifiable on-chain data, including the Credmark Framework used to evaluate RWA and lending protocols.

name: Maison
description: On-chain protocol for tokenizing luxury real-world assets (art, watches, collectibles) and other real-world goods, enabling fractional ownership and 24/7 trading.

name: Untangled Finance
description: Institutional-grade DeFi protocol for tokenizing private credit and real-world assets, providing curators with a hub to manage risk and liquidity for on-chain vaults.

name: Bloom Protocol
description: DeFi RWA-yield protocol connected to Blueberry Prime Brokerage that supports permissionless USDC decentralized yield (TBY + stUSD) and on-chain leverage against tokenized treasuries.

name: Fortunafi
description: All-in-one liquidity platform for stablecoin issuers, protocol treasuries and traditional entities, offering tokenized short-term US Treasury Bills (ifBILL) and other RWA products.

name: Credible Finance
description: Open payments stack for modern internet businesses that combines pay-in, pay-out, global collection accounts, on-chain liquidity and RWA collateral into a single platform.

name: Kinto
description: Ethereum L2 rollup with built-in permissionless KYC/AML and native account abstraction, designed to accelerate the transition to an on-chain financial system for RWAs and modular exchanges.

name: Spice AI
description: Portable, accelerated SQL query, search and LLM-inference engine written in Rust for data-grounded AI apps and agents, used by RWA protocols to power on-chain data analytics and decisioning.

name: Provenance Blockchain
description: Proof-of-stake blockchain purpose-built for financial services, built by Figure that hosts tokenized real-world assets, on-chain loan portfolios and Figure Markets, with HASH as the native asset.

name: Huma Finance
description: First PayFi (Payment Finance) network that turns real-world payment flows - invoices, receivables, cross-border remittances - into instant on-chain liquidity for businesses and institutions.

name: Tinlake
description: Centrifuge's flagship application (now Centrifuge V3) - a set of smart contracts that lets companies and individuals use tokenized non-fungible real-world assets (invoices, mortgages, royalties) as collateral to obtain on-chain liquidity.

name: Backed Finance
description: Swiss-regulated tokenization platform issuing fully backed, composable ERC-20 tokens (including the xStocks suite) that track the value of real-world assets such as equities, ETFs and bonds.

name: Brickken
description: Enterprise tokenization platform providing institutional-grade infrastructure to issue, manage and distribute digital assets and security tokens across multiple blockchains, with the BKN utility token.

name: Swarm Markets
description: BaFin-regulated end-to-end RWA protocol enabling the compliant tokenization and on-chain trading of public equities, bond ETFs and commodities such as gold.

name: Toucan Protocol
description: Carbon-credit market infrastructure that bridges, tokenizes and fractionalizes verified carbon credits (Nature Carbon Tonne, Base Carbon Tonne) on EVM chains, powering onchain climate finance.

name: Moss Carbon Credit
description: Each MCO2 token represents one verified carbon credit (1 tonne of CO2) tied to Amazon forest conservation, issued by Moss.Earth and used for transparent on-chain offsetting.

name: KlimaDAO
description: Decentralized autonomous organization and on-chain infrastructure for the voluntary carbon market - pools, bridges and the $KLIMA carbon-backed token driving price appreciation of tokenized carbon credits.
